import z3
import itertools
import time

n = 21
var = {}
solver = z3.Solver()

# Create boolean variables for each edge
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i+1, n):
        var[(i,j)] = z3.Bool(f"e_{i}_{j}")

print("Variables created:", len(var))

# Red=0 (False), Blue=1 (True)

# For each set of 5 vertices, at least one edge must be blue (True) to prevent red K5
# That is: OR_{i<j in S} (var[(i,j)]) must be True
for combo in itertools.combinations(range(n), 5):
    # at least one blue edge
    clause = z3.Or([var[(i,j)] for i, j in itertools.combinations(combo, 2)])
    solver.add(clause)

print("Red K5 constraints added")

# For each set of 4 vertices, at least one edge must be red (False) to prevent blue K4
# That is: OR_{i<j in S} (NOT var[(i,j)]) must be True
for combo in itertools.combinations(range(n), 4):
    clause = z3.Or([z3.Not(var[(i,j)]) for i, j in itertools.combinations(combo, 2)])
    solver.add(clause)

print("Blue K4 constraints added")

# Check
start = time.time()
result = solver.check()
print("Result:", result)
print("Time:", time.time() - start)

if result == z3.sat:
    model = solver.model()
    solution = []
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i+1, n):
            val = model.evaluate(var[(i,j)], model_completion=True)
            if z3.is_true(val):
                solution.append(1)
            else:
                solution.append(0)
    print("Solution:", solution)
else:
    print("UNSAT")
